title: True or false: Capital cities
intro: Decide whether each statement about the world is true. Every answer shows its source.

statements.text: Panama City is the capital of Panama.
statements.explain: Panama City is the capital of Panama.

statements.text: Niamey is the capital of Czechia.
statements.explain: The capital of Czechia is Prague, not Niamey.

statements.text: Georgetown is the capital of Guyana.
statements.explain: Georgetown is the capital of Guyana.

statements.text: Bridgetown is the capital of Eritrea.
statements.explain: The capital of Eritrea is Asmara, not Bridgetown.

statements.text: Cairo is the capital of Egypt.
statements.explain: Cairo is the capital of Egypt.

statements.text: Gaborone is the capital of Belize.
statements.explain: The capital of Belize is Belmopan, not Gaborone.

statements.text: Gaborone is the capital of Botswana.
statements.explain: Gaborone is the capital of Botswana.

statements.text: Ottawa is the capital of Senegal.
statements.explain: The capital of Senegal is Dakar, not Ottawa.

statements.text: Victoria is the capital of Seychelles.
statements.explain: Victoria is the capital of Seychelles.

statements.text: Accra is the capital of Somalia.
statements.explain: The capital of Somalia is Mogadishu, not Accra.

statements.text: Moscow is the capital of Russian Federation.
statements.explain: Moscow is the capital of Russian Federation.

statements.text: Vilnius is the capital of Uruguay.
statements.explain: The capital of Uruguay is Montevideo, not Vilnius.

statements.text: Dublin is the capital of Ireland.
statements.explain: Dublin is the capital of Ireland.

statements.text: Belmopan is the capital of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.
statements.explain: The capital of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is Kingstown, not Belmopan.
